description: The supplied image is not a scientific figure. It is a publisher/Crossref "Check for updates" badge: a square icon with a light grey-to-white gradient background, bounded by a thin grey border line at the top and left. At its centre is a segmented circular ring made of two arcs — a blue (cyan-blue) arc on the upper-right and a yellow arc on the lower-left — enclosing a solid red shape that resembles a downward-hanging banner or shield with a notched V-shaped bottom edge. Below the ring, two lines of bold dark-grey sans-serif text read "Check for" and "updates". There are no axes, no scale bar, no legend, no data points, no sample labels and no quantitative annotations of any kind. The image therefore carries no microstructural, diffraction, spectroscopic, mechanical or compositional information about the high-Al low-density medium Mn steel of the paper; it appears to be a metadata/article-tooling artefact captured in place of a real figure. Nothing in the image can be linked to any panel of a scientific figure, and no panel inventory is possible.
